correctness.rationale: For all prime powers q>=2, the partials (Z^q,X^q,Y^q) never vanish projectively, so Cq is smooth. Exact expansion at a point makes any tangent contact >=q; Bezout identifies q[P]+[R(P)] with R=cyclic permutation after Frobenius q^2. Thus maximal contact is precisely fixed R, and R^3=Frob_q^6 confines points to Fq6. Semilinear Hilbert 90 parametrizes fixed vectors as [a:a^(q4):a^(q2)] modulo Fq2*, and the curve equation is the trace Fq3/Fq of norm Fq6/Fq3(a), giving (q^2-1)(q^3+1)/(q^2-1)=q^3+1. For Fq3-fixed points, trace(a^2)=0 gives nonsingular conic q odd or line q even, q+1 points; Fq and Fq2 share h_q eigenlines. Degrees 1,3,6 count h_q,q+1-h_q,q^3-q; all orbit-size divisibilities hold. Fixed scheme reduced since derivative of purely inseparable R is zero. Independent finite-field arithmetic verified q=2 (9 points, 3+6) and q=3 (28 points, 1+3+24), using separate code; original verifier covers q=2,3,4,5. Finite fields corroborate but do not prove all q.
